chunks: What Firas narrated from al-Shaʿbi, from Ibn ʿAbbas, that he said:
ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام wrote to me concerning six brothers and a grandfather: “Consider him as one of them, and erase my letter.”

key_terms.اجْعَلْهُ كَأَحَدِهِمْ: Treat him as one of them in legal calculation or share allocation
key_terms.فِي سِتَّةِ إِخْوَةٍ وَجَدٍّ: A case involving six brothers and a grandfather in inheritance law

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام rule on inheritance when six brothers and a grandfather are present?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal instruction from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning inheritance involving six brothers and a grandfather. The ruling indicates that the grandfather is to be counted like one of the brothers in the distribution, reflecting an early juridical determination in inheritance law.
